headline: Casualties Spike Across Fronts as Bases Turnover Intensifies
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the slaughter has deepened on the major theatres. Weathered Expanse now records 1,326 Colonial and 1,187 Warden dead in the past two hours, up from roughly 800 each, while its 24‑hour base churn remains near 50 changes. Linn Mercy has erupted again, posting 1,521 Colonial and 2,078 Warden losses in the same window and logging 36 ownership events. Nevish Line, previously easing, surged to 1,543 Colonial and 1,690 Warden casualties with 52 base events in the last day. Mooring County’s grind accelerated to 884 Colonial and 547 Warden dead and 16 events. Callahans Passage, though still bloody, saw its two‑hour toll fall to 521 Colonial and 313 Warden amid 14 events. Marban Hollow, quiet in the prior report, produced 11 base changes with 463 Colonial and 510 Warden losses. Stonecradle added 8 events and higher losses on both sides. Dead Lands, Calahan’s Passage and several other sectors remain active but show no base turnover. Enlistments are climbing across all hot zones, feeding fresh manpower into the grinder while the majority of regions report no events.
